message.content: WolfgangSchulz's favorite risotto memory is the one he had in Venice. He described it as being creamy with seafood, noting that it was perfect for his palate. He expressed his love for seafood and mentioned that the risotto he enjoyed in Venice exemplified the quality and taste he appreciates in such dishes. This shared enjoyment of Italian cuisine, particularly seafood risotto, highlights WolfgangSchulz's positive experience and fond recollection of a culinary delight during his travels in Italy.
